title: Generalizable Museum Source Record
description: Unified record produced by the multi-source extractors under data/sources/. Designed so heterogeneous museum / academic / open-data sources can land in one downstream RAG pipeline. Empty fields MUST be null (or [] for arrays). Never fabricate values to fill gaps.

source_id.description: Original ID from the upstream source. For Met = objectID; for V&A = systemNumber; for Smithsonian = unit-prefixed object number; for CMA = id; for the two web sources = stable URL-derived slug.

period.description: Chinese-language period label, e.g. 北齐, 北魏晚期, 盛唐.

dynasty_en.description: English period label, e.g. Northern Qi, Northern Wei, Tang.

date_raw.description: The date string as it appears in the upstream source — DO NOT normalize.

description.description: ≤500 chars, copied from upstream verbatim (truncated). Do not paraphrase.
